news.title: ModShelf is now released!
news.caption: Download and manage Steam Workshop mods on iPhone.

apps.name: ModShelf
apps.subtitle: Steam Workshop downloads on iPhone
apps.localizedDescription:
ModShelf is a native SwiftUI client for the Steam Workshop. Sign in, paste a Workshop link or browse the Workshop in the built-in browser, and the mod downloads into its own folder, sorted by game.

Keep a library with search, tags, favourites and sorting, check mods for updates, verify files, and export anything as a ZIP.
apps.versionDescription:
- Library with per-game folders, search, tags and filters
 - Update checks, file verification and ZIP export

apps.name: IPAID
apps.subtitle: Edit IPA bundle IDs, names & schemes
apps.localizedDescription:
IPAID is an on-device utility for editing IPA bundle identifiers, display names, and URL schemes before signing or installing.

Manage app extensions, customize exported IPA filenames, and compare original and exported file sizes.

Useful for SideStore, AltStore, Feather, and LiveContainer workflows.
apps.versionDescription:
- Added About screen with GitHub, update checker, bug reports, feature requests, and optional support link
 - Added light/dark mode toggle
